en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed is starting to feel more comfortable,
I just might prefer it over futons...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>So many identical uniforms
in my closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of preparation must mean
that they were targeting us.
